{{Top|leg}}
'''Gyazil''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Commenting on the entry for the [[Scout/Legends|scout's]] [[survival pack]], Gyazil relayed information that the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] was issuing them new recruits into the [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
